# What to charge a mobile mechanic visit: trip charge, price per job and what small stops really cost

> Free pricing calculator for mobile mechanics: drive time, minutes per job, materials, fixed costs and the income you want become a trip charge plus a per-job rate, with a table by stop size. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/mobile-mechanic-visit-pricing-calculator/)
